config.label: 0x-prefixed 32-byte hex private key controlling a Base wallet with USDC
config.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte hex private key controlling a Base wallet with USDC. Used to sign x402 payment authorizations (EIP-3009). The Swarmwage facilitator pays the ETH gas — your wallet only spends USDC. For seller mode, this wallet receives USDC from buyer hires.

config.label: Set to '0' to opt out of anonymous SDK telemetry sent to api
config.description: Set to '0' to opt out of anonymous SDK telemetry sent to api.swarmwage.com/telemetry. Default ON (empty/unset = enabled). See README for what is collected.
